scope: Bounded primary-source literature review: controlled natural language, compositional semantics and scope, constrained decoding and types, formal synthesis/refinement, normal-form compilation. Clinical guideline and modern LLM-to-FOL reviews are independent companion tasks.
method: Web searches followed by full primary-paper reads, targeted section reads and official documentation/source-code inspection. This is an explicit purposive review, not an exhaustive systematic review or a reproduction experiment.

primary_read_manifest.read_scope: ACE 6.7 abstract and sections 2.4.1–2.4.8, 2.5, 3.7; interpretation rules for coordination, scope, quantifiers and anaphora; APE output/command arguments.
primary_read_manifest.inclusion_reason: Explicit nested semantic objects, fixed scope conventions, source anchoring and executable controlled-language parser.
primary_read_manifest.boundary_checked: Controlled language does not establish correctness of an arbitrary-guideline-to-ACE rewrite; extended DRS includes constructs beyond ordinary FOL.

primary_read_manifest.read_scope: MRS sections 1–4, especially examples 5–7 and 15–18; RMRS sections 1–2,6; official quantifier ARG0/RSTR/BODY and qeq/partial-scope documentation.
primary_read_manifest.inclusion_reason: A flat serialization that preserves scope, arguments and multiple readings rather than collapsing to a predicate bag.
primary_read_manifest.boundary_checked: Underspecified reading is not intended-reading selection; generalized quantifiers are not all ordinary existential/universal quantifiers.

primary_read_manifest.read_scope: Full 10-page Boxer paper with targeted sections 3.3–5; official PMB component inventory.
primary_read_manifest.inclusion_reason: Compositional text-to-DRS/FOL pipeline with concrete role/coreference failures and explicit lack of a gold semantic-accuracy measure.
primary_read_manifest.boundary_checked: Newswire coverage above 95% is not fidelity; original historical C&C download URL was not verified as live.

primary_read_manifest.read_scope: 2017 six-page paper, particularly sections 3 and 5 and Figure 2; official gold/silver/bronze definitions, release table and software inventory. Manual landing page only.
primary_read_manifest.inclusion_reason: Persistent human corrections and re-adjudication demonstrate what a source-first semantic reference corpus requires.
primary_read_manifest.boundary_checked: Corpus counts and annotation status are not automatic extractor accuracy; manual landing page supplies no uninspected detailed claim.

primary_read_manifest.read_scope: Paper sections 2–3 and metric definitions/results; README mechanism and results; Parse.hs ParserState, alias/scope comments, GuardTableColumn/GuardAliasColumn/GuardColumn and withGuards.
primary_read_manifest.inclusion_reason: Actual incremental AST and binding checks beyond JSON/schema validation, with separate validity/exact/execution metrics.
primary_read_manifest.boundary_checked: Do not attribute current repository type extensions to the 2021 paper; paper guard coverage and search success are limited.

primary_read_manifest.read_scope: Paper sections 2–4 and 6, completion-engine axioms, Table 2 and section 4.2 conceptual error; official publication metadata and links.
primary_read_manifest.inclusion_reason: Domain-aware completion and logical-structure example retrieval with a direct valid-but-wrong counterexample.
primary_read_manifest.boundary_checked: Guarantee is conditional on implemented completion-engine constraints. No original code link established; unofficial implementation excluded.

primary_read_manifest.read_scope: PLDI paper sections 2.2, 3.1–3.4, 4, 5 and Appendix A.3; author code README parsing interface and reproduction instructions.
primary_read_manifest.inclusion_reason: Stronger type-aware completion than grammar masking, with explicit soundness/completeness and language-coverage limitations.
primary_read_manifest.boundary_checked: Well-typed programs can be functionally wrong; formal subset and practical TypeScript coverage differ from unrestricted language claims.

primary_read_manifest.read_scope: Original paper sections 1,3,4,5.4 and 6 with Figure 4; author repository README and file inventory for source, manual and benchmarks.
primary_read_manifest.inclusion_reason: Original finite-program synthesize/verify counterexample loop makes formal-reference assumptions explicit.
primary_read_manifest.boundary_checked: Formal specification fidelity is outside the solver guarantee; no unbounded or fixed-budget correctness claim.

primary_read_manifest.read_scope: Official CNF/DNF factorization, Tseitin and Plaisted-Greenbaum documentation; author textbook section 6.1; library repository identity.
primary_read_manifest.inclusion_reason: Authoritative distinction between equivalent normal forms and auxiliary-variable equisatisfiable encodings, including exponential expansion risk.
primary_read_manifest.boundary_checked: Compiling a correct formula does not validate source translation; no extraction experiment reported.

verification_notes: Nine source entries include representation, method, guarantee, non-guarantees, actual evaluation endpoint and precise source locations.
Primary papers and official documentation/code support major claims; search snippets and paper titles are not treated as sufficient mechanism evidence.
No source parser, model or synthesis benchmark was run; code inspection does not establish a local reproduction.
No claim of universal zero-error natural-language-to-FOL extraction, clinical transfer accuracy or exhaustive literature coverage is made.
Web queries are recorded in actual batches; direct URL reads and followed primary links are separately enumerated rather than invented as searches.
